credentials.description: API key generated from the Africa's Talking dashboard (a new key invalidates the old one)
application username — always "sandbox" in the sandbox; sent as the username field of the body, not as a header
`senderId`: your registered short code or alphanumeric

example_prompt: Send an SMS to a list of phone numbers with Africa's Talking's current bulk endpoint (JSON).

input_schema.description: JSON body. Docs: "In addition to the standard request headers, this endpoint also accepts json requests." A second documented shape sends to a Safaricom hashed number (see gotchas).

phoneNumbers.description: A list of recipients' phone numbers. The docs' table says String, their JSON sample sends an array: ["+254711XXXYYY", "+254711YYYZZZ"]. Must be [] with maskedNumber.

message.description: The message to be sent. Avoid the % character (Help Center, see send_sms).

senderId.description: Your registered short code or alphanumeric. Required, except with maskedNumber where it is optional.

enqueue.description: 1 to queue the messages and send them asynchronously after responding to the request (default 1), 0 to disable.

maskedNumber.description: Hashed-number variant (Safaricom, Kenya): the string of the hashed number to be sent to. Required in that variant.

telco.description: Hashed-number variant: the service provider (the docs' sample: "Safaricom"). Required in that variant.

Message.description: Summary message (e.g. "Sent to 1/1 Total Cost: KES 0.8000").

statusCode.description: Status of the request for this recipient: 100 Processed, 101 Sent, 102 Queued, 401 RiskHold, 402 InvalidSenderId, 403 InvalidPhoneNumber, 404 UnsupportedNumberType, 405 InsufficientBalance, 406 UserInBlacklist, 407 CouldNotRoute, 409 DoNotDisturbRejection, 500 InternalServerError, 501 GatewayError, 502 RejectedByGateway.

status.description: Whether the sms was sent to this recipient or not. Docs: "This does not indicate the delivery status of the sms to this recipient."

messageId.description: The messageId received when the sms was sent — the id of its delivery report.

error_schema.description: Not documented on this page. The SMS Notifications page documents DoNotDisturbRejection (Nigeria) as an HTTP 409 with the usual SMSMessageData body.

gotchas: No sandbox yet: "Sandbox: https://api.sandbox.africastalking.com/version1/messaging/bulk (coming soon)". Test with send_sms (legacy endpoint, which has a sandbox) and switch to this one in production.
Recipients go in phoneNumbers, a list — the docs' JSON sample: "phoneNumbers": ["+254711XXXYYY", "+254711YYYZZZ"]. The legacy send_sms uses a comma separated string named to instead.
senderId is required here ("Your registered short code or alphanumeric"); the legacy endpoint's from is optional with a default.
Hashed numbers (Safaricom, Kenya): send maskedNumber and telco with phoneNumbers [] — "This value must be a blank list, i.e, []" — and senderId becomes optional.

Check SMSMessageData.Recipients[].statusCode for each recipient: 100 Processed, 101 Sent, 102 Queued; the docs list 401–502 as error codes. status "does not indicate the delivery status": the delivery comes later in webhook_delivery_report.
Help Center (Why did my messages Fail?): "Another reason that messages may fail to be sent is if they have the (%) percentage character in the text."
open_questions: Whether a form-encoded body (the standard Content-Type of the Request Headers page) works on this endpoint like JSON does, and how phoneNumbers is then encoded: the page only shows JSON requests.
